newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish EconMin welcomes Bank of Spain rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Spanish EconMin welcomes Bank of Spain rate cut.

text.p: The Spanish Economy Ministry on Friday welcomed the Bank of Spain's decision to cut rates and said the move was an endorsement of the government's policy.

"The decision taken today by the Bank of Spain is the consequence of a progressive clean-up of macroeconomic disequilibriums, especially in the reduction of inflation and control of the public deficit," the Ministry said in a statement.
Earlier, the Bank of Spain reduced its key money market rate to 5.25 percent from 5.50 percent.
The Ministry added that the cut would contribute to strengthening the process of recovery of the Spanish economy as well as stimulating productive investment.
